rules.text: Birth date is set by destiny and past-life karma; misuse of talents in past lives brings failures, hardship, losses now

source.quote: a result of a predetermined plan by Destiny, influenced by our Karma from previous lives

rules.say: Your birth date reflects a plan shaped by destiny and karma from past lives. Talents misused in past lives can bring failures, hardship and losses now.

rules.text: Must work exceptionally hard for any task; constant challenges; low success rate tempts giving up; pessimism

source.quote: will need to exert exceptional effort to achieve any task

rules.say: You may need to put in exceptional effort for any task and face constant challenges. When success is slow, you may feel like giving up or turn pessimistic.

rules.text: Traits: blames others for limits and failures; authoritative, rigid, "my way or the highway"; controlling; pessimistic; lazy

source.quote: Adopting an \"it's my way or the highway\" mentality

rules.say: Take care of blaming others for your limits, being rigid or controlling ('my way or the highway'), pessimism and laziness.

rules.text: Keys: focus on one goal in a set time; ethics and sincerity, no shortcuts; discipline (timetable, appointments, commitments); cleanliness, no procrastination

source.quote: resist the temptation of choosing the easy or expedient path

rules.say: Focus on one goal within a set time, stay ethical and sincere, and avoid shortcuts. Keep discipline with timetables and commitments, keep things clean, and do not procrastinate.

rules.text: Abused freedom in past births; must adapt to constant change; acute danger of addictions (drugs, alcohol, food, sex)

source.quote: Acute danger of falling prey to traps and addictions

rules.say: This number is linked with misused freedom in past births, so you must adapt to constant change. Take great care, as there is an acute danger of addictions like drugs, alcohol or food.

rules.text: Traits: craving freedom undermines relationships; boredom in jobs and relationships, commitment issues; excess sexual interest; addictions incl. overeating, gambling; feels trapped; poor self-control

source.quote: Struggling with commitment issues.

rules.say: Your craving for freedom can harm relationships and bring boredom and commitment issues. Take care of addictions like overeating or gambling, poor self-control and feeling trapped.

rules.text: Keys: moderation; emotional stability and supportive people; focus, flexibility; commitment to truth; avoid unnecessary expense and instant gratification; can achieve material and spiritual progress

source.quote: consciously engage in activities with moderation

rules.say: Practise moderation, stay emotionally stable and keep supportive people close; be focused, flexible and committed to truth. Avoid needless spending and instant gratification, and you can progress materially and spiritually.

rules.text: Old to new, profound transformation; plans blocked; ego crumbles in defeat; surrender to higher force; spiritual rebirth, humility

source.quote: In times of defeat, your ego will undergo a painful process of crumbling

rules.say: This number brings deep change from old to new, and your plans may get blocked. In defeat your ego may crumble, leading to humility, surrender and spiritual rebirth.

rules.text: Traits: aloof, excessive solitude, many failed relationships, self-absorbed, hard to connect emotionally

source.quote: You have encountered numerous unsuccessful relationships.

rules.say: You may be aloof, self-absorbed and keep too much to yourself, finding it hard to connect emotionally. Many of your relationships may not have worked out.

rules.text: Keys: drop egotism; accept divine will; apologise and repent for hurt caused; accept life's purpose is divine, surrender to God

source.quote: Apologize and Repent for the Hurt You've Caused

rules.say: Let go of ego and accept divine will; apologise and repent for any hurt you have caused. Surrender to God, accepting that your life's purpose is divine.

rules.text: Learning independence and right use of power; support doesn't come, so learns self-reliance; must not refuse help or advice; self-made prison, hard to open to love

source.quote: avoid stubbornly refusing help or disregarding well-meaning advice

rules.text: Traits: selfish, manipulative, egotistical, low confidence, over-dependent, stubborn, can't assert, driven excluding others, appearance-focused, materialistic show, narcissistic, lazy, superficial

source.quote: Selfishness - Being focused on personal gain at the expense of others.

rules.say: Linked with tendencies like selfishness, ego, manipulation, stubbornness, over-dependence, laziness and a love of show. Take care not to seek personal gain at others' cost.

rules.text: Keys: build reciprocal bonds of trust; embrace empathy, we are all interconnected

source.quote: establishing meaningful and reciprocal bonds of trust is crucial

rules.say: Build meaningful bonds of trust that work both ways, and embrace empathy, remembering that we are all connected.

rules.text: Karmic debt: selfishness in love, power, work or freedom in past lives; now is the chance to set it right

source.quote: numbers 13, 14, 16, and 19 (karmic debt numbers) are about selfishness in love, power, work, or freedom in past lives

rules.say: Your birth date carries a karmic debt number, linked with selfishness in love, power, work or freedom in past lives; now is your chance to set it right.

rules.text: Signals working with issues from the past; most significant in personal year, destiny, birthday

source.quote: These numbers will show up as your birthday number or destiny number, it’s a signal that you’re working with issues from the past.

rules.condition: birthday or destiny in {13, 14, 16, 19} before reducing
rules.say: As 13, 14, 16 or 19 shows up as your birthday or destiny number, it signals that you are working through issues from the past.

rules.text: The 3 in 13: creativity and joy turned into frivolity and superficiality

source.quote: The number 3 in 13: creativity energy and joyfulness turn into frivolity and superficiality.

rules.say: In your karmic number 13, the creativity and joy of 3 can turn into frivolity and superficiality, so take care with this.

rules.text: The 4 in 14: discipline and stability turned into rebelliousness and indulgence

source.quote: The number 4 in 14: discipline, hard work, accountability, and stability turn into rebelliousness and indulgence

rules.say: In your karmic number 14, the discipline, hard work and stability of 4 can turn into rebelliousness and indulgence, so take care with this.

rules.text: The 6 in 16: love and commitment forsaken

source.quote: The number 6 in 16: love and commitment have been forsaken.

rules.say: In your karmic number 16, the 6 shows that love and commitment were forsaken in the past, so take care to honour them now.

rules.text: The 9 in 19: wisdom, spiritual knowledge and power used for personal gain

source.quote: The number 9 in 19: wisdom, spiritual knowledge, and power have been used for personal gain.

rules.say: In your karmic number 19, the 9 shows that wisdom, spiritual knowledge and power were used for personal gain in the past, so take care to use them well now.

rules.text: Karmic completion and rebirth: the debt is paid, free to begin again; a chance to stand on your own and use the good traits of 1-9

source.quote: The number 10 means karmic completion, and is the number of rebirth.

rules.say: The 10 in your birth date means karmic completion and rebirth: the debt is paid and you are free to begin again, standing on your own with the good traits of every number.

rules.text: Fortunate; promise of victory in difficult situations; go forth with courage

source.quote: The 10 is considered a fortunate number and holds the promise of victory in difficult situations.

rules.say: The 10 in your birth date is considered fortunate and holds the promise of victory in difficult situations, so go forth with courage.

rules.text: Usually shows a past misuse of personal power; now use courage, independence and leadership

source.quote: the 10 usually indicates there has been a past misuse of personal power

rules.say: The 10 in your birth date usually shows a past misuse of personal power; now is the time to use your courage, independence and leadership well.

rules.text: Not bad luck but hard work everywhere; discipline in expression and practical matters; no shortcuts

source.quote: While the number 13 is usually associated with bad luck, when it appears as a karmic debt number, it’s not about luck.

rules.say: Your karmic number 13 is not about bad luck but about hard work in every area, with discipline in how you express yourself and in practical matters; there are no shortcuts.

rules.text: Often shows the negative traits of 4: rigid, controlling, dogmatic, blaming others for limits

source.quote: Usually people with 13/4 will exhibit the negative traits of the 4

rules.say: With karmic number 13, you may show the negative side of 4: being rigid, controlling or dogmatic, and blaming others for your limits, so take care with this.

rules.text: Success by keeping order: keep appointments, follow through on commitments, keep the house tidy, never procrastinate; steady effort brings reward

source.quote: If you make a steady and consistent effort, you will find reward and success.

rules.say: With karmic number 13, success comes from keeping order: keep appointments, follow through on commitments, keep your home tidy and never procrastinate. Steady, consistent effort brings reward.

rules.text: Do not despair: many famous people have 13 birthdays

source.quote: Many famous people carry karmic 13 birthdays.

rules.say: Do not despair about carrying 13 in your birth date: many famous people have a karmic 13 birthday.

rules.text: Past lives abused freedom; rebellious free spirit; huge risks for sensual pursuits

source.quote: The karmic number 14/5 involves past lifetimes where freedom was abused.

rules.say: Karmic number 14 is linked with freedom abused in past lives; you may be a rebellious free spirit who takes huge risks for pleasure, so take care.

rules.text: Negative traits of 5: jumping between relationships or jobs, seeking pleasure (food, sugar, sex, drugs); craving the new over steady work

source.quote: jumping from relationship to relationship or job to job, for example- with no sense of accomplishment or goal firmly in mind.

rules.say: With karmic number 14, take care with the negative side of 5: jumping between relationships or jobs, chasing pleasures like food, sugar, sex or drugs, and craving the new over steady work.

rules.text: The key is commitment, moderation, order and temperance; stay flexible, do not become rigid

source.quote: The key to this karmic debt number is commitment

rules.say: The key to your karmic number 14 is commitment, moderation, order and temperance, while staying flexible and not becoming rigid.

rules.text: Expect emotional upsets and delays

source.quote: If you have 14 as your Personal Year Number, you might expect emotional upsets and delays.

rules.say: If your personal year adds up to 14 before reducing to 5, you may expect emotional upsets and delays this year.

rules.text: Lessons through setbacks, disappointments, reversal of fortune; must make commitments and ride the ups and downs

source.quote: If 14 is your Destiny Number, then you’ll possibly learn these lessons through setbacks, disappointments, and reversal of fortune

rules.say: With 14 as your destiny number, you may learn life's lessons through setbacks, disappointments and reversals of fortune; make commitments and ride the ups and downs.

rules.text: Here to learn to let go, resist indulgence, allow change, steer a steady course

source.quote: If 14 is the number of your Date of Birth, you are here to learn to let go, resist the temptations of indulgence

rules.say: Born on the 14th, you are here to learn to let go, resist the pull of indulgence, allow change and steer a steady course.

rules.text: "Universal Law #5": you are never given more than you can handle; temperance in all things

source.quote: You’re never given more than you can handle.

rules.say: With karmic number 14, remember that you are never given more than you can handle, and practise temperance in all things.

rules.text: Past illicit love affairs that hurt others; failure to act responsibly in love

source.quote: The karmic debt of the 16/7 arises from past involvement in illicit love affairs that caused suffering to others

rules.say: Karmic number 16 is linked with past love affairs that hurt others and a failure to act responsibly in love, so take care to love responsibly now.

rules.text: Negative traits of 7: indifference, aloofness, withdrawal, hard to approach, privacy over others' feelings, intellectualising emotion

source.quote: Indifference • Analytical aloofness • Withdrawal • Difficult to approach

rules.say: With karmic number 16, take care with the negative side of 7: indifference, aloofness, withdrawal, being hard to approach and putting your privacy before others' feelings.

rules.text: Tarot Tower: sudden falls and rebirth; humility is the key to future success; key word "awaken"; spiritual growth

source.quote: it’s precisely this humility that’s the key to future success.

rules.say: Karmic number 16 is linked with sudden falls followed by rebirth and spiritual growth; humility is the key to your future success.

rules.text: Will know alienation and loneliness; tends to look down on others

source.quote: the 16/7 won’t be a stranger to alienation and loneliness in this lifetime.

rules.say: With karmic number 16, you may know alienation and loneliness and may tend to look down on others, so take care with this.

rules.text: Life is a series of falls and rises until the spiritual lesson is learned

source.quote: your life will be a series of events that bring you to the bottom, only to rise up again, to fall again, and so on.

rules.say: With 16 as your birthday or destiny number, life may bring a series of falls and rises until its spiritual lesson is learned.

rules.text: Past abuse of power, completely self-centred; lesson is standing on your own and using power properly

source.quote: the karmic debt of this number stems from past abuses of acting in a completely self-centered manner

rules.say: Karmic number 19 is linked with past abuse of power and acting in a self-centred way; your lesson is to stand on your own and use power properly.

rules.text: Negative traits of 1: selfishness, intimidation, dependence, not standing up for oneself, refusing help, egotism, laziness, aggression

source.quote: Selfishness • Intimidation • Dependence

rules.say: With karmic number 19, take care with the negative side of 1: selfishness, intimidation, dependence, ego, laziness, aggression, and refusing help or not standing up for yourself.

rules.text: Often left to stand alone; refusing help can become a self-imposed prison; blames others for own dependence

source.quote: Because of a tendency to stubbornly resist help from others, you may find yourself in a self-imposed prison.

rules.text: Success by looking past your own needs to others'; work toward independence; the 1 promises a new beginning

source.quote: Success comes from looking past your own needs to the needs of others.

rules.say: With karmic number 19, success comes from looking past your own needs to the needs of others and working towards independence; the 1 promises a new beginning.
